title: ai.json
description: spm skill manifest: declares target vendors and skill git dependencies.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

targets.description: Vendors the skills are materialized for.

skills.description: Skill dependencies, keyed by local name.

plugins.description: Full-plugin dependencies (agents, MCP servers, hooks, scripts and bundled skills), keyed by local name. The `path` points at a Claude Code plugin root (a directory containing `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`).

git.description: Git repository URL (https, ssh, scp-style, or file://).

path.description: Subdirectory within the repo (monorepo of skills).
